channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Amb. Danon warns Hezbollah: 'Do not attempt to exploit Israel’s election period'
item.description: Israel’s Ambassador to the UN, Danny Danon, issues a direct warning to Iran and Hezbollah: 'Anyone who dares to attack us will face a devastating response.'

item.title: Report: Israel raised alert level over a possible security threats to elections
item.description:
Israel has raised its level of alert in recent days amid concerns over a possible security escalation, less than two weeks before the elections, Kan News reported.
At this stage, there is no concrete information indicating that Iran or Hezbollah intends to attack, but the IDF is monitoring missile and drone tests being conducted by Iran.
A security official said: “We are acting to ensure that we are not caught by surprise."

item.title: Trump cancels planned livestream of Fort Hood terrorist's execution
item.description: President Donald Trump announces that Nidal Hasan's execution will proceed by firing squad, but will not be broadcast to the public. Victims' immediate families will be permitted to attend.

item.title: IDF arrests key terrorist weapons trader in Jenin
item.description:
This morning (Thursday), IDF soldiers completed a special operation in the Jenin area. During the operation, IDF soldiers, guided by the Shin Bet, apprehended a terrorist who was affiliated with the Jenin terror network, which was dismantled during Operation “Iron Wall," an operation aimed at dismantling terrorist networks in Northern Samaria.
The terrorist served as a key weapons trader and, during his involvement with the network, operated to acquire and transfer weapons to the Jenin terror network.

item.title: Watch: A chase in Rahat ends with a surprise for Border Police officers
item.description: During an operation targeting illegal residents in Rahat, Southern District Border Police officers spotted a motorcyclist riding without license plates and after a chase found he was riding a stolen vehicle.

item.title: Israel leads top European economies in 2026 growth forecast
item.description: Israel's economy is projected to grow by 4.5% in 2026, the highest rate among countries classified by the IMF as Advanced Europe, ahead of Malta at 4.2% and Denmark at 3.7%.

item.title: Health Ministry unveils long-term plan to address Israel’s shortage of medical specialists
item.description: A Health Ministry report projects the number of doctors in Israel will surge from approximately 37,000 to 53,000 within a decade, while the number of specialists will rise from about 20,300 to 32,000.

item.title: Eisenkot vows to destroy Hamas within 18 months of becoming PM
item.description: Yashar! chairman Gadi Eisenkot pledges to end Hamas rule in Gaza, dismantle its military wing within 18 months if elected Prime Minister, drawing sharp criticism from Likud and Amcha Yisrael.

item.title: Prime Minister to convene meeting with defense establishment chiefs
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu will convene a security meeting this evening with the heads of the defense establishment, including IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir, Mossad Director Roman Gofman, Shin Bet Director David Zini, and Defense Minister Israel Katz.

item.title: Liberman draws red line: No Netanyahu, no minority government
item.description: Yisrael Beytenu chairman Avigdor Liberman declared that he would not join a government led by Netanyahu or support a minority government as a temporary solution, outlining his proposed framework for the next coalition.
